<hr>
<pre>public static final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapPolyline.DashRepresentation</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Represents a dash pattern for map polyline where the dash can be rendered as a colored
 line and the gap can be either empty or colored.
 <p>The length of the dash and gap are set independently, allowing for patterns
 like <code>' — — — —'</code> (dash length = gap length) or <code>' ——— ——— ———'</code> (dash length != gap length).</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>DashRepresentation</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;DashRepresentation&#8203;(@NonNull
                          <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;lineWidth,
                          @NonNull
                          <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;dashLength,
                          @NonNull
                          <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;gapLength,
                          @NonNull
                          <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;dashColor)
                   throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a representation for a dashed line. Gaps are not displayed.
 <p>At map measures smaller than the smallest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>,
 <code>dashLength</code> and <code>gapLength</code>, the value used for rendering is constant
 and equal to the value given for the smallest map measure in the
 respective <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</code></a> object.
 <p>At map measures bigger than the biggest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>,
 <code>dashLength</code> and <code>gapLength</code>, the value used for rendering is constant
 and equal to the value given for the biggest map measure in the
 respective <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</code></a> object.
 <p>At map measures between two nearest given map measures, the values are
 linearly interpolated between values given for these map measures.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure.Kind</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> is supported.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>RenderSize.Unit</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit#PIXELS"><code>RenderSize.Unit.PIXELS</code></a> is supported.
 <p>All sizes must not be 0 (<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize#sizes"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize.sizes</code></a> with all values set to 0.0).</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>lineWidth</code> - <p>The width of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
<dd><code>dashLength</code> - <p>The dash length of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
<dd><code>gapLength</code> - <p>The gap length of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
<dd><code>dashColor</code> - <p>The dash color of the polyline.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>In case of invalid input parameters.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getLineWidth</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;getLineWidth()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the map measure dependent polyline width.
 <p>At map measures smaller than smallest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>
 line width is constant and equal to the width given for the smallest
 map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>.
 <p>At map measures bigger than biggest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>
 line width is constant and equal to the width given for the biggest
 map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>.
 <p>At map measures between two nearest given map measures, the values are
 linearly interpolated between values given for these map measures.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The width of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<dd><p>The dash length of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getGapLength()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getGapLength</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;getGapLength()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the map measure dependent polyline gap length.
 <p>At map measures smaller than smallest map measure in the <code>gapLength</code>
 line width is constant and equal to the width given for the smallest
 map measure in the <code>gapLength</code>.
 <p>At map measures bigger than biggest map measure in the <code>gapLength</code>
 line width is constant and equal to the width given for the biggest
 map measure in the <code>gapLength</code>.
 <p>At map measures between two nearest given map measures, the values are
 linearly interpolated between values given for these map measures.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The gap length of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getDashColor()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getDashColor</h4>

public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;getDashColor()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the color of the dashes of the polyline.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The color of the dashes of the polyline.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getGapColor()">

</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getGapColor</h4>

public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;getGapColor()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the color for the gaps of the polyline. Returns <code>null</code> if no
 color is used.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The color for the gaps of the polyline. The default value is <code>null</code> and
     no color is used.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
